# opnsense_dnsmasq_settings (Resource)

Manages dnsmasq general listener settings. Import the singleton before use. Omitted settings retain their current OPNsense values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_settings" "dns_listener" {
  enabled                  = true
  interfaces               = ["lan"]
  strict_interface_binding = true

  # Keep dnsmasq available for DHCP/RA while BIND owns port 53.
  dns_port = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dns_port` (Number) DNS listener port. Set to `0` to disable only the DNS function while keeping dnsmasq available for DHCP or router advertisements.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the dnsmasq service.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Logical interfaces on which dnsmasq is allowed to listen.
- `strict_interface_binding` (Boolean) Bind only to the selected interfaces instead of wildcard sockets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `dnsmasq_settings`.
